title: Rewriting Scaling Laws for Synthetic Data with Compute and Data Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2610.31867v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Synthetic rewrites, where a language model rewrites a natural document e.g. into a target style, are now a standard ingredient of pretraining corpora. However, critical aspects of their use remain poorly understood, such as how much compute should be spent rewriting training data and whether a model trained on rewrites can outperform the rewriter. We study these two questions by proposing a rewriting scaling law that predicts loss from model size, training tokens, the fraction of training tokens that are rewrites, and the number of epochs over the natural data, charging the compute spent generating rewrites. We fit this scaling law in two settings. In the compute-limited setting, natural data is plentiful and rewrites come from a third-party rewriter trained with more compute than our largest run. We find that the estimated optimal rewrite fraction increases with compute, from under $10\%$ at $3\times10^{18}$ FLOPs to $32\%$ at $10^{22

translated_title: 在计算与数据约束下重写合成数据的缩放定律
translated_abstract: 合成重写是指由语言模型对自然文档进行重写（例如转换为目标风格），这如今已成为预训练语料库的标准组成部分。然而，其使用中的若干关键问题仍知之甚少，例如：应该花费多少计算量来重写训练数据，以及在重写数据上训练出的模型能否超越重写器本身。我们通过提出一个重写缩放定律来研究这两个问题，该定律根据模型大小、训练词元数量、训练词元中重写数据所占比例以及在自然数据上的训练轮数来预测损失，并将生成重写所花费的计算量计入总成本。我们在两种设置下拟合了该缩放定律。在计算受限的设置中，自然数据充足，重写数据来自一个用比我们最大规模训练运行更多计算量训练的第三方重写器。我们发现，估计的最优重写比例随计算量的增加而上升，从3×10¹⁸ FLOPs时的不到10%上升到10²²时的32%。
tldr: 本文提出了首个面向合成重写数据的缩放定律，将生成重写的计算成本纳入建模，发现最优重写数据比例随计算预算的增加而显著上升。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a rewriting scaling law that accounts for the compute spent generating synthetic rewrites, finding that the optimal rewrite fraction in training data increases substantially with the compute budget.
